name: Azeroth Companion
title: SOVEREIGN CHARACTER NEXUS — The Living Player Experience
approval_note: Owner explicitly authorized v15 implementation and release. Live Blizzard account data and physical device acceptance remain pending.
features: Sovereign Character Nexus v15 connects a selected local character with its manual builds, adventure plans and research studios.
Official public Blizzard character profiles and equipped item IDs/levels can now be loaded on demand, with source labels.
Character-linked Talent Forge launch safely preselects only a uniquely matching official specialization; original rank controls remain intact.
Living Equipment Intelligence places public equipped items beside personal Item Atlas tracking without inventing upgrades or ownership.
Personal Adventure Command unifies existing character objectives and links back to the original functional quest planner.
Portable build packages export linked manual drafts, optional goals and notes; validated guest imports never overwrite original builds.
Owner-approved Discord releases continue with tester acceptance explicitly pending; cinematic design, music and account security remain preserved.
